scope: Baseline b89b957. Full static review of DirectDownloader.kt, ResumeJournal.kt and DirectDownloaderTest.kt, limited to resume ETag validation, Content-Range validation and network interruption. Also inspected HttpRepresentation.kt and ResumeJournalTest.kt for context. No source edits, emulator use or deployment; tests were read but not executed.

test_gaps.scenario: A second network interruption during an already resumed 206 response, followed by another new downloader instance.
test_gaps.assertion: The new checkpoint preserves the original total and ETag, advances only to durable bytes, and the third request starts at that checkpoint and yields exact final bytes.
test_gaps.status: Untested path; no defect established. Existing interruption test covers an interrupted initial 200 followed by a successful 206.

test_gaps.scenario: Resume redirect resolves to a different final URL while returning the same ETag and Content-Range.
test_gaps.assertion: The destination and prior checkpoint remain intact when targetHash validation rejects the response.
test_gaps.status: Untested validation branch; code explicitly checks targetHash before opening the destination.

test_gaps.scenario: Chunked 206 response with a valid Content-Range but a truncated body or extra bytes.
test_gaps.assertion: The transfer fails, preserves only a safe durable prefix, and a later retry cannot publish a truncated or overlong file.
test_gaps.status: Untested path; existing wrong-length test supplies a known Content-Length and is rejected before append. No defect established.

test_gaps.scenario: Failure during journal replacement or process termination between file sync and checkpoint replacement.
test_gaps.assertion: The previous checkpoint remains readable and never points beyond durable destination bytes; orphaned pending state is handled on the next attempt.
test_gaps.status: Untested crash/failure durability assumption. Static ordering is file sync, pending journal sync, atomic move; no crash defect established.

test_gaps.scenario: A complete checkpoint (offset equals total), a destination shorter than checkpoint offset, and an unknown-length initial transfer interrupted after receiving a strong ETag.
test_gaps.assertion: Complete checkpoints trigger origin revalidation via a plain GET; short local files restart; unknown-length responses do not create resumable checkpoints.
test_gaps.status: Untested boundary branches; the reviewed implementation explicitly handles each and no defect was established.
